enedkeg-ün ubaday-a ǰin-a mitr-a kiged yeke dokiyalduγuluγči kelemüči bande yesesde orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai, kümün-ü eǰen dai erke-tü delekei-dekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliq-iyar samdan sengge mongγolčilan orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai

hindkeg-ün keleber, ubadiy-a zan kiged öčigči yeke kelemürči banḓhi yeses sdhe orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad / orosiγulbai, mongγol-un keleber küdga odser mergen manǰusri banḓiḓa-tur dulduyidču mati badr-a sagar-a širi <badr-a toyin čorǰi> orčiγulbai. , .

enedkeg-ün ubadyay-a jin-a mitir-a kiged, yeke / tokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bandê yesêsdê orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. , . / kümün-ü eǰen ṱai erketü delekei-tekin-ü qormusta-yin ǰarliγ-iyar, samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče / mongγol-un kelen-tür orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. , .
